7.t: Working with data: putting it all together
q: Which surface gave the fastest trolley?
Rougher surfaces give more friction, which acts against the motion, so the trolley speeds up less and is slower.
Suggest how the results could help design a safe slide for a playground.
A slide that is too smooth makes children (users) go too fast: choose a surface with some friction, add a gentler run-off at the end so users slow down over a longer distance; test with real speeds.
